Hi Asha —

Great to meet on the call earlier. Quick recap from my side so you have a single place to reference:

- Goal: pilot low-latency inference for transaction risk scoring (95th pct < 50ms end-to-end).
- Data & security: must run in a VPC with customer-controlled keys; no raw PII leaves environment.
- Throughput: expect spikes to ~250 qps during peak batch windows, sustained 30–50 qps otherwise.
- Success criteria: latency, stable cost per 1M tokens, and a plan to move to dedicated capacity if the pilot looks promising.

Attached are the two-slide recap and a quick latency profile I captured from the demo (Discovery-Recap-Slides.pdf; Latency-Profile-Screenshot.png).

Next steps I suggested on the call:
- 30-min follow-up with your infra lead to validate VPC/KMS constraints
- If positive, schedule a short engineering trial (2–3 weeks) we can scope together

If Redwood is not the right fit here, a one-line reply saying so would save us both time — otherwise, are you available for a 30-min technical sync next week (Wed/Thu afternoon PT)?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
